response.original_title: ((FAQS Guest))- How can I add a guest to my Royal Caribbean cruise?
response.overview: To add a guest to your Royal Caribbean Cruise, +1-833-624-0944(US) you must contact Royal Caribbean Cruises customer service or your travel agent directly, as passenger additions cannot be processed online. Call Royal Caribbean Cruises directly if you booked on your own, +1-833-624-0944(US) or reach out to your travel advisor if you used an agency. Have the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and Captain's Circle number (if they have cruised with Royal Caribbean before) ready. To add a guest to an existing Royal Caribbean cruise, you must call Royal Caribbean Customer Service directly at +1-833-624-0944(US) or contact your travel agent, as passenger additions cannot be processed online.
